verdict.rationale: Khoj's self-hosting and 'never share data outside device' claims (khoj-docs-3, khoj-docs-38) plus an admin panel for server settings (khoj-docs-20) support local data control, and users manage the files/notes Khoj indexes (khoj-docs-18/33). But there is no explicit documentation of a distinct 'memory' store, no described UI/API to inspect, edit, or delete what the assistant has remembered from conversations, and no confirmation the storage format is open/inspectable (vector DB internals aren't documented; probes for API/spec return 404). missing for 10: explicit memory inspection/edit/delete feature, confirmation of open storage format, independent verification of local-only memory persistence.
